## Model 4.1

The data used in `m4.1` comes from `Howell1`:

```{r}

data("Howell1") 

d <- Howell1[ Howell1$age >= 18 , ]

head(d)

```





The model is defined as follows:

```{stan, eval=FALSE,output.var="m4.1", code=readLines('models/m4-1.stan')}

```
